4/7/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

June 23rd 1916

Sir,
The Police of the French Concession on June 22nd
seized 11 parcels each containing 50 pamphlets (twenty
five printed in Hindustani and twenty five printed
in French) in a Chinese medicine establishment which
bears the name of the Whatah dispensary and the address
of which is 63 Rue Petite Shanghai.
The parcels were marked "per Hollandische Mail"
"via New York" and were consigned to the above address.
The proprietor of the shop who has been arrested
and is detained at the French Central Police Station admits
having had business dealings with A. Nielsen but he denies
that he knows for what purpose the parcels were addressed
to him. He received them through the Chinese Post Office
in the month of February last and has been using some as
wrappers for his medicine bottles.
Specimens of the pamphlets referred to are
attached herewith.

Your Obedient Servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

asP
S
I have informed Mr. Philips, who will get
into touch with French authorities.
Please look into the attached Indian document &c.
& he is here to compare the two pamphlets.
23/6/16.
Kms
cas

1916年7月4日

上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探科。）

1916年6月23日

先生，
法租界警方于6月22日
在一家名为“华达药房”（Whatah dispensary）、
地址为上海小马路63号（63 Rue Petite Shanghai）的
中药铺内，查获了11个包裹，每个包裹内装有
50本小册子（其中25本以印度斯坦语印刷，
25本以法文印刷）。
这些包裹标记为“经荷兰邮船”（per Hollandische Mail）
“经由纽约”，并寄往上述地址。
该店店主已被捕，目前拘押于法国中央巡捕房，
他承认曾与 A. Nielsen 有业务往来，但否认
知晓这些包裹寄给他的目的。他是通过
中国邮政在上个月（二月）收到这些包裹的，
并一直将其中一些用作药瓶的包装纸。
随函附上所述小册子的样本。

您忠实的仆人，

首席侦探督察。

警察署长。

asP
S
我已通知菲利普斯（Philips）先生，他将
与法国当局取得联系。
请查阅附上的印度文件等，
他在此处以便比较这两份小册子。
1916年6月23日。
Kms
cas
